description: This Java class 'AdvicePoint' encapsulates data related to a point of advice in the OpenMRS module system. It manages details such as the advice point location, associated module, class name, and class instance, providing methods for instantiation, retrieval, and disposal.

classes.name: AdvicePoint
classes.description: Represents a point of advice within the OpenMRS module system, providing mechanisms to instantiate and manage associated class instances.

methods.name: AdvicePoint(String point, Class<?> clazz)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the advice point and attempting to create a new instance of the given class.

methods.name: AdvicePoint(Module mod, String point, String className)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the advice point with module, point, and class name.

methods.name: getPoint()
methods.description: Returns the point string of the advice point.

methods.name: getClassInstance()
methods.description: Returns the associated class instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: disposeClassInstance()
methods.description: Disposes of the stored class instance by setting it to null.
